instruction: Candid action photograph, medium close-up. In an indoor judo dojo, the young man with stubble (R4) on the left, wearing a white judogi with blue shoulder stripes, leans forward to grip the lapel of the older man (R3) on the right. The older man (R3), in a white judogi, leans backward defensively. They are captured mid-sparring with a shallow depth of field under bright, natural indoor light.
elements: R4 leans forward to grip R3's lapel during the sparring exchange
R3 leans backward defensively while R4 applies the lapel grip
R4 is the active lapel-gripping grappler and R3 is the defensive partner
R3's judogi lapel is the contact point being gripped
The sparring occurs in an indoor judo dojo

questions.q: Is R4 leaning forward to grip R3's lapel, rather than R3 leaning forward to grip R4's lapel?
questions.element: R4 initiates the lapel grip on R3

questions.q: Is R3 leaning backward defensively while R4 presses in with the lapel grip, rather than R4 being the one leaning backward defensively?
questions.element: R3 is the defensive backward-leaning partner

questions.q: Does R4 hold R3's judogi lapel as the gripping contact, rather than R3 holding R4's judogi lapel?
questions.element: R4 grips R3's lapel, not the reverse

questions.q: Is R4 the active grappler applying the lapel grip while R3 reacts in a defensive posture?
questions.element: R4 has the active gripping role and R3 has the defensive role
